notes.title: Announcing release date for SANONTA - Finnish Proverb Game
notes.notes:
Hi!
We’re glad to announce our little project, SANONTA – Finnish Proverb Game.
Release date is 6th of December 2022!

SANONTA means “saying” or “proverb” in Finnish. Finland will celebrate it’s 105th Independence day on 6th of December and we’ve decided to publish a silly cultural project to celebrate it. Don’t worry, it’ll cost less than one bag of salmiakki!

In SANONTA, you play simple memory games (featuring cute Finnish animals) and clicker games in order to advance and unlock English translated Finnish proverbs and sayings. Some of the proverbs are full of wisdom, some of them are imbued with folksy humor.
In addition to proverbs, our hostess Aino will tell you fun and interesting facts about Finland.

The past year has been a difficult one for Europe, as most of us have been faced with the fact that things like independence and freedom should never be taken for granted. Every country on European soil has their own unique history, culture and identity. SANONTA is a small sneak peek to Finland.

Eir,
Nevan Games Studio
